title: Adsorption Information Format (AIF)
description: Dictionary for STAR format adsorption experiment and simulation data files
$comment: Properties are organized into logical sections via 'definitions'. Each section groups related CIF-style data names by prefix. The schema is composed using 'allOf' references so that all section properties are validated together.

audit.$comment: Audit: Version and format tracking. Required for every AIF file.

_audit_aif_version.description: Version of the AIF data-name dictionary used by this file

_audit_creation_date.description: Date and time the AIF file was created in ISO 8601 format

_audit_creation_software.description: Name and version of the software used to generate this AIF file

experimental.$comment: Experimental: Conditions, methods, and operator details for the adsorption experiment. These are scalar (single-value) metadata fields that describe the overall experiment.

_exptl_operator.description: Name of the person who performed the experiment

_exptl_digitizer.description: Name of the person who digitized the data, if extracted from a published figure or table

_exptl_date.description: Date and time of the experiment in ISO 8601 format

_exptl_instrument.description: Identifier or model name of the instrument used for the measurement

_exptl_adsorptive.description: Common name of the adsorptive gas or vapour, e.g. Nitrogen, CO2, Water
_exptl_adsorptive.x-dic-common:
Required field. The common or IUPAC name of the gas/vapour
used as adsorptive in the experiment or simulation.

_exptl_adsorptive_name.description: Alternative or secondary name for the adsorptive, e.g. chemical formula or abbreviation

_exptl_temperature.description: Temperature at which the experiment was conducted (see _units_temperature)

_exptl_method.description: Experimental technique used to measure the amount adsorbed
_exptl_method.x-enum-description: Method used to determine amount adsorbed.

x-enum-descriptions.simulation: Data originates from molecular simulation rather than experiment.

_exptl_isotherm_type.description: Classification of the reported adsorbed amount

_exptl_p0.description: Saturation pressure of the adsorptive at the experimental temperature (see _units_pressure)

adsorbent.$comment: Adsorbent / Sample: Identification, physical properties, and degassing conditions for the adsorbent material.

_adsnt_material_id.description: Name or designation of the adsorbent material, e.g. UiO-66, Zeolite-13X
_adsnt_material_id.x-dic-common:
Required field. The name of the material, e.g. the common name,
CSD refcode, or other standard identifier.

_adsnt_info.description: Free-text field for additional information about the adsorbent sample

_adsnt_hashkey.description: Machine-readable hash key for programmatic identification of the adsorbent

_adsnt_structure_csd_refcode.description: Cambridge Structural Database (CSD) reference code for the adsorbent structure

_adsnt_structure_topology.description: Network topology descriptor (e.g. RCSR symbol) for the adsorbent

_adsnt_structure_smiles.description: SMILES of the organic linker or building block of the adsorbent

_adsnt_composition.description: Chemical composition or formula of the adsorbent, e.g. Cu3(BTC)2

_adsnt_molar_mass.description: Molar mass of the adsorbent formula unit (see _units_molecular_weight)

_adsnt_synthesis.description: Synthesis route or details used, e.g. solvothermal, mechanochemical, reference to MPIF, etc

_adsnt_sample_id.description: Unique sample identifier assigned by the operator or laboratory
_adsnt_sample_id.x-dic-common:
Required field. A unique identifier for the specific sample
used in the experiment.

_adsnt_sample_mass.description: Mass of the adsorbent sample used in the measurement (see _units_mass)

_adsnt_sample_density.description: Bulk or skeletal density of the adsorbent sample (see _units_density)

_adsnt_degas_summary.description: Human-readable summary of the degassing procedure and conditions

_adsnt_degas_temperature.description: Temperature at which the sample was degassed prior to measurement (see _units_temperature)

_adsnt_cycle_number.description: Adsorption-desorption cycle index (1-based) for multi-cycle studies

adsorptive.$comment: Adsorptive: Physical and chemical identifiers and properties of the adsorptive molecule.

_adsorptive_id.description: Common name of the adsorptive gas or vapour, e.g. Nitrogen, CO2, Water
_adsorptive_id.x-dic-common:
Required field. The common or IUPAC name of the gas/vapour
used as adsorptive in the experiment or simulation.

_adsorptive_info.description: Alternative or secondary name for the adsorptive, e.g. chemical formula or abbreviation

_adsorptive_inchi.description: IUPAC InChI identifier of the adsorptive

_adsorptive_cas.description: CAS Registry Number of the adsorptive

_adsorptive_smiles.description: Canonical SMILES string of the adsorptive

_adsorptive_kinetic_diameter.description: Kinetic diameter of the adsorptive molecule (see _units_kinetic_diameter)

simulation.$comment: Simulation: Computational method details for simulated isotherms (e.g. GCMC, MD). Only relevant when the data originates from molecular simulation rather than experiment.

_simltn_code.description: Name and version of the simulation software, e.g. RASPA 2.0, LAMMPS

_simltn_date.description: Date and time the simulation was performed in ISO 8601 format

_simltn_size.description: Description of the simulated system size, e.g. number of unit cells or particle count

_simltn_forcefield_adsorptive.description: Force field or interaction model used for the adsorptive, e.g. TraPPE, OPLS-AA

_simltn_forcefield_adsorbent.description: Force field or interaction model used for the adsorbent framework, e.g. UFF, DREIDING

_simltn_input_files.description: URL or repository link to the simulation input files and scripts

_simltn_sampling.description: Phase-space sampling method used, e.g. GCMC, MD, Widom insertion

_simltn_lot.description: Level of theory for the calculation, e.g. DFT, machine-learned potential, classical force field

instrument.$comment: Instrument: Detailed instrument provenance for traceability, calibration records, and quality management.

_instrument_model.description: Model name or number of the instrument

_instrument_firmware_version.description: Firmware or software version of the instrument

_instrument_last_calibration_date.description: Date of last instrument calibration in ISO 8601 format

_instrument_equilibration_criterion.description: Criterion used to determine equilibrium at each data point

_instrument_leak_rate.description: Measured leak rate of the instrument manifold (see _units_leak_rate)

_instrument_dead_volume.description: Total dead (free-space) volume of the measurement cell (see _units_dead_volume)

_instrument_reference_material.description: Certified reference material used for instrument validation

units.$comment: Units: Measurement unit definitions for all numerical quantities. These scalar fields declare the units used throughout the file so that data columns can be interpreted correctly.

_units_temperature.description: Unit of temperature for all temperature values in this file, e.g. K, °C

_units_pressure.description: Unit of pressure for all pressure values in this file, e.g. kPa, bar, mmHg

_units_mass.description: Unit of mass for all mass values in this file, e.g. g, mg, kg

_units_loading.description: Unit of amount adsorbed for all loading values in this file, e.g. mmol/g, cm3(STP)/g, wt%

_units_density.description: Unit of density for all density values in this file, e.g. g/cm3, kg/m3

_units_time.description: Unit of time for all time values in this file, e.g. s, min, hours

_units_composition_type.description: Definition of how mixture compositions are expressed, e.g. mole_fraction, mass_fraction

_units_enthalpy.description: Unit of enthalpy values in this file, e.g. kJ/mol

_units_surface_area.description: Unit of surface area values in this file, e.g. m2/g

_units_pore_volume.description: Unit of pore volume values in this file, e.g. cm3/g

_units_pore_diameter.description: Unit of pore diameter values in this file, e.g. nm

_units_molecular_weight.description: Unit of molecular weight values in this file, e.g. g/mol

_units_kinetic_diameter.description: Unit of kinetic diameter values in this file, e.g. angstrom

_units_dead_volume.description: Unit of dead volume values in this file, e.g. cm3

_units_leak_rate.description: Unit of leak rate values in this file, e.g. Pa/min

_units_quadrupole_moment.description: Unit of quadrupole moment values in this file, e.g. Debye·Å

adsorption_data.$comment: Adsorption Data: Loop columns for the adsorption branch of the isotherm. These fields appear inside a CIF loop_ construct, with one row per equilibrium point.

_adsorp_pressure.description: Equilibrium pressure at each adsorption data point (see _units_pressure)

_adsorp_fugacity.description: Fugacity of the adsorptive at each adsorption data point (see _units_pressure)

_adsorp_p0.description: Saturation pressure at each adsorption data point, for use in relative pressure calculations (see _units_pressure)

_adsorp_amount.description: Amount adsorbed at each adsorption data point (see _units_loading)

_adsorp_amount_excess.description: Excess amount adsorbed at each adsorption data point (see _units_loading)

_adsorp_amount_absolute.description: Absolute amount adsorbed at each adsorption data point (see _units_loading)

_adsorp_amount_net.description: Net amount adsorbed at each adsorption data point (see _units_loading)

_adsorp_molefraction.description: Mole fraction of the adsorptive in the gas phase for a multicomponent adsorption measurement (see _units_composition_type)

_adsorp_selectivity.description: Adsorption selectivity for a specified component pair under the given conditions (unitless ratio)

desorption_data.$comment: Desorption Data: Loop columns for the desorption branch of the isotherm. Mirrors the adsorption data section for the reverse process.

_desorp_pressure.description: Equilibrium pressure at each desorption data point (see _units_pressure)

_desorp_fugacity.description: Fugacity of the adsorptive at each desorption data point (see _units_pressure)

_desorp_p0.description: Saturation pressure at each desorption data point, for use in relative pressure calculations (see _units_pressure)

_desorp_amount.description: Amount remaining adsorbed at each desorption data point (see _units_loading)

_desorp_amount_excess.description: Excess amount remaining adsorbed at each desorption data point (see _units_loading)

_desorp_amount_absolute.description: Absolute amount remaining adsorbed at each desorption data point (see _units_loading)

_desorp_amount_net.description: Net amount remaining adsorbed at each desorption data point (see _units_loading)

_desorp_molefraction.description: Mole fraction of the adsorptive in the gas phase for a multicomponent desorption measurement (see _units_composition_type)

_desorp_selectivity.description: Desorption selectivity for a specified component pair under the given conditions (unitless ratio)

analysis.$comment: Analysis: Derived scalar quantities from standard analysis methods (BET, Langmuir, pore characterization). These are single-value metadata fields summarising the analysis results.

_analysis_method.description: Analysis method(s) or description used for derived quantities, e.g. BET and HK

_analysis_bet_pressure_range_min.description: Lower bound of the relative pressure range used for BET fitting

_analysis_bet_pressure_range_max.description: Upper bound of the relative pressure range used for BET fitting

_analysis_micropore_volume.description: Micropore volume from t-plot or DR analysis (see _units_pore_volume)

_analysis_total_pore_volume_pp0.description: Relative pressure p/p0 at which total pore volume was evaluated

_analysis_psd_method.description: Method for determining pore size distribution, e.g. NLDFT-Carbon-N2

analysis_psd.$comment: Analysis PSD: Loop columns for pore size distribution data. One row per diameter bin.

_analysis_psd_diameter.description: Pore diameter in a pore-size distribution loop (see _units_pore_diameter)

_analysis_psd_dv_dd.description: Differential pore volume dV/dD at each diameter in a PSD loop

analysis_fit_summary.$comment: Analysis Fit Summary: Loop columns for recording fitted isotherm models. One row per model, linked to fit parameters via _fit_id.

_fit_id.description: Unique integer key identifying this fit within the file

_fit_model.description: Name of the fitted isotherm model, e.g. Langmuir, DSL, Toth

_fit_r_squared.description: Coefficient of determination (R-squared) for the fit

analysis_fit_parameters.$comment: Analysis Fit Parameters: Loop columns for the parameters of each fitted model. Linked to the fit summary via _fit_param_id referencing _fit_id.

_fit_param_id.description: Foreign key referencing _analysis_fit_id in the fit summary loop

_fit_param_name.description: Name of the fitted parameter, e.g. q_max, K_L, n

_fit_param_uncertainty.description: Uncertainty of the fitted parameter value

_fit_param_unit.description: Unit of the fitted parameter, e.g. mmol/g, 1/Pa

citation.$comment: Citation: Bibliographic reference for the source publication or dataset.

_citation_doi.description: Digital Object Identifier (DOI) of the publication associated with this data

_citation_source.description: Bibliographic source of the data, e.g. journal name, book title, or database

data.$comment: Data Provenance: Authorship, licensing, and cross-references to related AIF files, databases, and datasets for FAIR data practices.

_data_license.description: License under which the data is distributed (SPDX identifier preferred), e.g. CC-BY-4.0

_data_orcid.description: ORCID iD of the data author or contact person

_data_contact_email.description: Contact email for inquiries about the data

_data_related_dataset_url.description: URL to the dataset in an external repository

_data_related_nist_isodb_id.description: NIST/ARPA-E ISODB identifier for this dataset

data_related.$comment: Data Related: Loop columns for cross-references to related AIF files in the same collection. One row per related file.

_data_related_aif_file.description: Filename or path of a related AIF file in the same collection

_data_related_aif_relationship.description: Description of the relationship to the related AIF file, e.g. cycle 1 of same sample, same sample different gas

.*_uncertainty$.$comment: Any data name ending in '_uncertainty' is treated as the uncertainty (error bar) for the corresponding base field.
.*_uncertainty$.description: Uncertainty (standard or expanded) associated with the corresponding data name, in the same units
